notes.title: Final Release
notes.notes:
After a long hiatus here, I'm back to share the [b]big and long-awaited news[/b]:

[h1]Raccoo Venture has a release date![/h1]

That's it! Now you will be able to explore the world of Verta, find 140+ collectibles, solve puzzles and battle bosses, in its [b]complete version[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/0b211c01c2c7e34a3d7335e92bfc181a8bab7f40.jpg[/img]

I can't thank all the players who participated in the Early Access version and provided their feedback enough. Thanks to you, Raccoo Venture has become a much better, more fun and more polished game than its initial version. From gameplay improvements, performance to sound and visual effects.
And of course, I need to thank you for your patience for believing in this game and trusting my work over all these years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/bdf7190332f6a3ace97c940f529603cac74267ef.jpg[/img]

It took 5 years of hard work, overcoming difficulties and obstacles in all spheres, and now seeing the final product is very gratifying. I am very pleased with the result and I hope that you all can have a lot of fun with the adventures of our beloved raccoon. I can't wait to share the results of this journey with everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/29e88b7264371961fbc81f7261f714a85788749b.jpg[/img]

So without further ado, save the date:

[h3]Raccoo Venture launch
December 14, 2023[/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.1.417
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

In this update I bring another new level to the Lurra region with a beautiful oasis! (Hope you found some breathing orbs)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/168ec22296dfc946fdbc01343813eefc7c369f73.jpg[/img]

New original soundtracks on all stages have also been added. Goodbye royalty free songs! Hehehe...

As with all updates, I'm always improving some details in gameplay and fixing some bugs that are reported by you.

I hope you are enjoying this journey. We are almost at the final stretch, there are few levels left to finish the game. If all goes well, by early 2022 the game will be complete \o/

Thanks to everyone who has followed the development, for their patience, affection, support and all the feedbacks, without it the game would not have evolved this way.

See you next update 
and have a good play!
Diego Ras.

notes.title: Update 1.1.415
notes.notes:
Hi everybody, I hope you all are well and safe.

It's been a while since the last update and I know you might be wondering about it. But don't worry about it, I only took a few days to rest a bit and recharge my batteries, as it's been almost 3 years working on this game without a day off. I also took the opportunity to go after some other resources in order to better promote the game (news coming soon! ːsteamhappyː ). But now things are back to normal and are in full swing!

Lets go to what matters!
In this new update, I bring you a new level, new skins and new music!

Now we can go a little further into the desert region of Lurra and take a few more steps towards the end of this journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/8b9783f771393fe7b838349d61788b8cc2ef17de.jpg[/img]

In addition to the skin you can find in the new level, two more new skins have been added in Orniton Store. Will you recognize these new references?

The songs from World 3 arrived, and now the journey through Verta Central has gained a whole new tailor-made atmosphere.

In addition to those new elements, improvements were made, mixing adjustments and bug fixes, such as the bug where Trinca Tronco ​​appeared at the checkpoint even after being defeated! Spooky!

For now that's it guys, I hope you enjoy the news and have fun. Soon I will have some really cool news for the game.

We are reaching the final stretch and I sincerely thank each one of you who have supported the game!

Have a good play!
Diego Ras.

notes.title: Update 1.1.351
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello folks!

I bring you this great Raccoo Venture update!
Let's check out the news and changes that this new update brings to you:[/h3]

[h2]News:[/h2]

[h3]•New level[/h3]
Now we will be able to unveil the secrets of Four Falls Temple, which has the most challenging puzzles in the game so far.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/ee29de6188fc351230b8b8a134cb5f7b2a8e6a8e.png[/img]

[h3]•New boss fight[/h3]
Fatuus Fire is prepared and will do anything to prevent Raccoo from recovering the chess set.

[h3]•New costume[/h3]
A brand new costume to increase the wardrobe!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/92e087393b605e20e2a4fd537447ff2e1d591a5a.png[/img]

[h3]•Soundtrack[/h3]
In this new version we can check out some songs that are already part of the new original soudtrack. They are in: main menu, level selection world, Raccoo's house and also in the intro cutscene. 
The other songs will gradually be implemented in the game in next updates.

[h2]Modifications[/h2]

[h3]•Momentum/inertia[/h3]
A large part of the community complained about the lack of inertia in Raccoo's movement, which was one of the major changes in this new version, bringing inertia to the movement, giving greater immersion and perception of Raccoo's weight while moving.

[h3]•Saving Checkpoints[/h3]
Imagine this situation: You activated a checkpoint and then killed all enemies and solved a puzzle, but now you can't save it again!
With this update, another big change that has happened is that you can save a checkpoint again whenever you want, standing over it and pressing Y on the controller or E on the keyboard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/8d3d00c58dedf3f3f456fa27db3bf1e7b98f5824.png[/img]

[h3]•Levels' names[/h3]
Now the levels have an index in their names (1-1, 1-2, 1-3, etc.), to facilitate the location and communication between all players in the community.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/32bfb17f87253527659a4ec46d970f0798581f01.png[/img]

[h3]•Throw/drop[/h3]
There was also an improvement in the throwing/droping system, preventing you from ending up throwing an object when in fact you just wanted to put it on the ground, simply because Raccoo was not 100% stopped.

[h3]There are also other fixes and minor general improvements.[/h3]

That's it! I hope you all enjoy it.
Leave in the comments what you thought about these news and what you would like to see in the next updates.

See you soon, have a good play!

Join our community
[url=https://discord.gg/AQcnfcY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/a43fb4d4f1c78e512f27ff63b8b3f54c11247d3f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 1.1.344
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,
I bring you Raccoo Venture updates.
There are many cool features that came into the game to make it even more fun.
So let's check it out:

[h2]•Save Slots[/h2]
Many players asked me for a way to have differents save files in Raccoo Venture, as they would like to try new games without losing what has already been achieved or even for their companions and children could have their own progress saved independently.
Raccoo Venture will have 3 different game slots to choose, called "game cartridges".

•[b]Attention: Your previous game will be saved as "Cartridge A".[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/a45229573e714f692bfd64f49d1083c2b0fd6d50.gif[/img]

[h2]•Steam Cloud[/h2]
Along with the ability to save different games, you can now also count on [b]Steam Cloud[/b] so you can always keep playing from where you stopped, regardless of which computer you're playing on.

[h2]•Exclusive Early Access Costume[/h2]
As a way of thanking the players who has trusted and supported [b]Raccoo Venture[/b], all those who acquire the game in Early Access period will have an exclusive costume as a souvenir of our EA journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/f5b311cefbed688d3b66bef6391f45165b3e26bc.jpg[/img]

[h2]•"Tupple K.O." system and "Hit Combo"[/h2]
Nothing is more fun than being rewarded for defeating the countless [i]Tattooed Tatus[/i] that we find along the way, right?
From now on you will earn bonuses by defeating more than 1 armadillo at the same time or by defeating some armadillos in a row.
So use your creativity and have fun with this new feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/aca7cafdaeb19770f8b331583744c5a28b253ec7.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/bbf2f96b570555803118a76e8268c88f5260742c.gif[/img]

[h2]•Sacis and Breathing Orbs Counters[/h2]
Now you can check out how many Sacis you've found looking at the [b]new Sacis Chest[/b] at Raccoo's house and also you can check your Orbs by taking a look at the [b]Fridge Magnets[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/7c6b8ee58f779ef18467b4770b88ecd8247f5735.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/ce069439ac41eb1d1db1c0f40fbcd26a9d99a71c.gif[/img]

[h2]•New level, new enemy and new costume[/h2]
Giving continuity to the adventures of Verta's hero, a new level is available: [b]Serene Lake[/b], which brings new challenges and a new enemy for you to defeat.
Of course, a [b]new outfit[/b] can be found to make Raccoo more and more elegant. 
As usual, this new costume is very well hidden so you can have fun looking for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/bcae17a618f6610db9c830fdeb3d164095ab78fe.jpg[/img]

[h2]•Fixes and improvements [/h2]
In addition to all the new features, minor reported bugs was fixed and also control response via keyboard was improved.

That's it folks. I hope you enjoy the news. Soon I will bring more updates and improvements to make Raccoo Venture an increasingly fun game.

Keep sending your feedbacks and suggestions because they are very important.
Thank you very much for your trust and support.

[h3]Join our Community:[/h3] [url=https://discord.gg/AQcnfcY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/a43fb4d4f1c78e512f27ff63b8b3f54c11247d3f.png[/img][/url] 

Diego Ras.

notes.title: Update 1.1.339
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

In this update I bring some new features, small details that will make the experience of playing Raccoo Venture even better.

[h1]Volume adjustment and in-game options[/h1]

Many players asked for a volume control and also a way to change the game settings during the gameplay. Now it's possible by accessing the options menu in the pause screen, where you can adjust the graphics, sounds and language settings.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/2c528135be242fbb1a66980b8eb1bb8306141a59.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/2c528135be242fbb1a66980b8eb1bb8306141a59.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]New language: German[/h1]

Wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
Yeah! Now Raccoo can be played in German, a [b]big thanks to Flo Baramundi[/b] who provided the German localization!


[h1]Total played time and "death counter!?"[/h1]

Now it's much easier for you to track how long you've been looking for the sacred relics. The pause menu has a total played time counter. Unfortunately this counter is not retroactive and only starts counting from now on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34108236/f40633f00ebf7e00c51c95a4c90b21a28d0774b9.png[/img]

But what is that? A death counter?
Dying in the game is something that happens quite often and it is very common for players to be curious about how many times they had to repeat their adventures until it worked. 
I hope you enjoy this idea!

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

In this version, several bugs that were reported by the community during this first month of early access were fixed. Here is a list of some fixed errors:
[list]
[*] Mushrooms don't respawn after the checkpoint.
[*] Button at the end of level 8 repeats Pru's animation.
[*] Raccoo gets "stuck" in some places in the switches room in level 7.
[*] The Shaman's Temple doesn't open again after the checkpoint.
[*] And many other minor fixes made.
[/list]

What did you think about these news? Have you seen any of these bugs?
Leave your comment telling your opinion!

Thank you very much and see you next time!
